name: pdk-xray-core-348
instr:
Xray-core is in `/app`. Routing rules with thousands of domains and a mix of substring and regex patterns spend too much time resolving destination domains. Improve the performance of `RoutingRule.BuildCondition().Apply` for domain rules; a rule with several thousand domains and dozens of keyword patterns should handle repeated lookups several times faster, without noticeably slowing smaller or larger rule sets.

Keep domain, full, substring and regular-expression matching correct for mixed hit/miss traffic, including case-insensitive domain lookups. Existing public signatures and unrelated DNS behavior must remain intact. The container is offline. Changes are checked with the repository's original tests restored and with fresh routing inputs of several sizes; outputs must match the original behavior. The external-network-dependent tests `TestLocalNameServer` and `TestDomainSniffing` and the intermittent `TestDialAndListen` and `TestVMessGCMMuxUDP` are excluded. From `/app`, run `go test -vet=off ./app/router ./common/strmatcher` to check local behavior; the repository has matcher benchmarks you can run locally.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /app/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works.
